Protocol library
Where to measure protocol values
Ka,r rate: measure or verify at the interventional reference point (IRP), or use the corresponding console / RDSR reference-air-kerma rate for that protocol. PKA rate: use the integrated KAP/DAP meter at the collimator housing, or an equivalent calibrated meter intercepting the full beam. Beam time should come from the fluoroscopy timer, cine duration, or RDSR event duration. When you enter these protocol values, the simulator will apply your measured rates to all linked exposure events.
Protocol libraries are saved as one JSON file containing all saved protocols and their measured Ka,r and PKA rates.
RDSR / dose-report import
Import exported CSV/JSON records locally, or select a binary DICOM RDSR (.dcm). Binary DICOM parsing loads dcmjs only when needed.
Supported RDSR-style fields
The importer recognises common concepts/aliases including Acquisition Protocol, Irradiation Event Type, Irradiation Duration, Reference Point Air Kerma, Dose Area Product / KAP, Positioner Primary Angle, Positioner Secondary Angle, Source-to-Detector Distance, table positions, FoV and collimation. Missing geometry fields use the current live settings.
Model notes
Each stored event freezes its geometry and dosimetry inputs. Protocol-derived events retain their protocol link, so updating a protocol’s measured rates recalculates events that used that protocol measurement. Events based on direct cumulative values or manual/estimated rates remain independent.
